sentences.en: As to the source of this statement, I know nothing.
sentences.zh: 关于这个陈述的来源，我一无所知。

sentences.en: The Prime Minister is feeling the heat over his statement.
sentences.zh: 总理因他的发言正承受着压力。

sentences.en: He assures us that he didn't attach a false statement.
sentences.zh: 他向我们保证，他没有提交虚假的报告。
